LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 3.1.1 LISTENING FOR INFORMATION AND THE MAIN IDEA

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for information and the main idea
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for information and the main idea, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do you get the main points from an oral text? 2. Why should you capture the main ideas from a speaker?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for information and the main idea together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: A learner listen keenly and respond to oral texts.

● Digital literacy: A learner use digital devices with assistive technology to search online for expressions that signal the

main idea and specific information.

Values:
Respect: A learner listen to peers read descriptive texts and note the main ideas, in turns.

Link to other subjects:

Kiswahili and other language subjects address listening for the main idea and specific information.

Suggested Learning Resources

Audio recordings, braille reading materials
